episodes.title: Welcome to Upload
episodes.summary: After a self-driving car crash, Nathan is uploaded to Lakeview, his girlfriend's family's digital after-life, where he meets his customer service rep, Nora.

episodes.title: Five Stars
episodes.summary: Nora tries to get her ratings up, so her boss will approve her dad's upload loan. Nathan acclimates to his new world with the help of a Lakeview therapist.

episodes.title: The Funeral
episodes.summary: Scientists attempt to download a consciousness back into a clone body. Nathan attends his own funeral and Nora uncovers a mystery surrounding his death.

episodes.title: The Sex Suit
episodes.summary: Nora thinks she may have misjudged Nathan. Nathan and his girlfriend Ingrid are interviewed about the challenges of romance between a living person and an Upload.

episodes.title: The Grey Market
episodes.summary: Nora's Dad's vape lung worsens while Nathan, his friend Luke, and Dylan, an uploaded teen whose body is not keeping up with his age, visit a hacker's market in cyberspace.

episodes.title: The Sleepover
episodes.summary: Nathan is thrown when Nora goes on a Nitely date. Ingrid invites Nathan's niece for a sleepover. Nathan and Nora suspect his damaged memories may lead to a greater conspiracy. Luke gets into a fight with Aleesha.

episodes.title: Bring Your Dad to Work Day
episodes.summary: Nathan takes Nora's dad on a do-or-die upload decision tour, but things go awry when Luddites sabotage Lakeview. Nora does some sleuthing on Lucy's computer in the confusion.

episodes.title: Shopping Other Digital After-Lives
episodes.summary: After a surprising revelation, Nathan shops for a new digital after-life. Nora travels to LA to help Ingrid stop him from leaving Lakeview.

episodes.title: Update Eve
episodes.summary: The Uploads are looking forward to the improvements in the new Lakeview Operating System. Nathan and Nora stay up late to recover Nathan's missing memories.

episodes.title: Freeyond
episodes.summary: Nathan's restored memories and shifting emotional allegiances put Nora in physical danger.

episodes.title: Welcome Back, Mr. Brown
episodes.summary: While living with Ingrid, Nathan searches for Nora, who has fled off the grid.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.summary: At a status-obsessed dinner, Nathan faces ghosts from his past. Nora flexes her programming skills as she steps into activism.

episodes.title: Robin Hood
episodes.summary: Frustrated with the inequities at Lakeview, Nathan and Luke decide to redistribute some wealth with Ingrid's unwitting help. Nora undertakes a secretive mission.

episodes.title: Family Day
episodes.summary: Nora's loyalties are stressed as she is called upon to take revolutionary action. Nathan's visiting family prompts him to consider what he wants out of his afterlife. Luke invents a new sport.

episodes.title: Mind Frisk
episodes.summary: Nathan and Nora race to stop a potentially dangerous technological advance. Luke boycotts sleep when he finds Horizen is profiting from his dreams, as Aleesha continues to rise in the Horizen hierarchy. Ingrid is tempted by a new tech offering: digital babies.

episodes.title: The Outing
episodes.summary: Nora and Aleesha pursue the mystery into New York City with Nathan and Luke along on screens. Ingrid receives unexpected visitors.

episodes.title: Download
episodes.summary: Nora rallies the support of unlikely allies and Hyperloops to LA. Meanwhile, the issues in Nathan's personal life come to a head.

episodes.title: Ticking Clock
episodes.summary: Nora and a recently downloaded Nathan race to stop Freeyond before his head explodes.

episodes.title: Strawberry
episodes.summary: Nathan and Nora struggle to make their relationship work, while Ingrid tries to make the best of her second shot at love.

episodes.title: CyberDiscountDay
episodes.summary: The gang celebrates CyberDiscountDay while Nora discovers something game-changing: Nathan has been copied in Lakeview.

episodes.title: Download Doctor
episodes.summary: Nathan and Nora track down the doctor who invented download, while Aleesha rises higher in the Horizen hierarchy. Ingrid and back-up Nathan grow closer.

episodes.title: Rescue Mission
episodes.summary: Nathan teams up with his own copy to save Luke, but Nora is discovered by the conspiracy.

episodes.title: Memory Crackers
episodes.summary: Nora and Nathan find important clues to expose Freeyond, but the search poses a challenge to their relationship.

episodes.title: Upload Day
episodes.summary: Nathan and Nora try to have a special last day together.

episodes.title: Flesh and Blood
episodes.summary: Nora takes the powerful Upload companies to court, but she may have bitten off more than she can chew.

episodes.title: Wedding Weekend
episodes.summary: One Nathan celebrates a bitter-sweet wedding, but things are not what they seem and questions of sanity and religious faith are raised. A lonely AI Guy searches for romance. Aleesha prepares for her new responsibilities while Luke agonizes over their kiss back in Lakeview.

episodes.title: Workload
episodes.summary: The bride and groom save up for their honeymoon. Horizen-Betta debuts a new, money-making technology. Luke tries to enjoy his job at Workload, and the AI Elevator Operator splits off an AI Girl and falls head over heels.

episodes.title: Spa Day
episodes.summary: While on their honeymoon, the newlyweds uncover a dark secret. Luke and the AI Gardener head back into the Grey Zone on a rescue mission. Aleesha reveals surprising abilities and Nora and Ingrid share clues.

episodes.title: Mile End
episodes.summary: Series finale. The residents of Lakeview race to find justice, revenge and peace as the digital and real worlds collide.
